80332.subject: 🕵️ ZachXBT infiltrates Chinese crime syndicate
80332.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $86,233 (0.2%) | **ETH** $2,710 (-0.1%) | **SOL** $120 (-0.2%)

* ZachXBT says he infiltrated a Chinese crime syndicate that laundered more than $1 billion for [Lazarus Group](https://x.com/zachxbt/status/2107081638073319437)

* OpenAI is in talks with UAE funds, including MGX, for a [$30B-plus round](https://cryptobriefing.com/openai-seeks-30b-funding-at-14t-valuation-with-uae-blackrock-bloomberg/) at a $1.4T pre-money valuation

* The US Treasury withdraws two proposals targeting [unhosted wallets](https://x.com/AggrNews/status/2107099466805211307) and crypto mixing

* Solana launches an open-source [DvP program](https://x.com/DecryptMedia/status/2107290306613846152) for institutional trade settlement with J.P. Morgan input

* Ondo Finance launches tokenized notes tied to private tech companies, starting with a [pre-IPO AI firm](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2107372965566333323)

* S&P Global Ratings launches a risk assessment framework for onchain lending vaults as sector deposits reach [$10 billion](https://cryptobriefing.com/sp-global-ratings-onchain-lending-vaults/)

* Strategy bought [334.3 BTC](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2107077494763405597) worth about $29 million — Posts its [first quarterly profit](https://x.com/business/status/2107087160968962117) in four quarters as Bitcoin rally drives $21 billion Q3 gain

* OKX launches OKX Money, a stablecoin app where qualifying USDG balances earn [up to 10% APY](https://cointelegraph.com/news/okx-money-stablecoin-savings-payments-emerging-markets) — Raises capital at a [$25B valuation](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2107445766776390046?s=20)

* Chainalysis finds wallets sending P2P stablecoin transactions in China grew [43x](https://cointelegraph.com/news/china-stablecoin-p2p-wallets-crypto-restrictions) from Q1 2024 to Q2 2026

* Moonshot AI closes final private round at [$50 billion valuation](https://x.com/business/status/2107301072951738829) targeting a Hong Kong IPO in early 2027

* DeepSeek is close to securing at least [$12 billion](https://cryptobriefing.com/deepseek-nears-12-billion-funding-2027-ipo/) ahead of planned early 2027 IPO

* Stripe plans to expand stablecoin cards to [over 100 countries](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/10/01/stripe-to-expand-stablecoin-cards-to-over-100-countries-by-the-end-of-the-year) by year-end

* DeFi Development Corp adds about 26,203 SOL between Sept. 28 and Oct. 2, reaching roughly [2.56 million SOL](https://x.com/solananew/status/2107090293254410447)

* Tech billionaires drive all 2026 gains on Bloomberg Billionaires Index as non-tech members lose a combined [$62 billion](https://x.com/business/status/2107058223916183603)

* CFTC reportedly proposes its first [formal crypto market rules](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2107131516807426311), replacing enforcement-only approach with new CTX and CAM regulations

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin stalls below $87K as bond yields bite, yet Washington is easing off self-custody and mapping a regulated path for retail leverage, while Solana, Stripe and Ondo push settlement, payments and private markets onchain. 📉 Bitcoin Hits the $87K Wall for a Third Time BTC slipped about 1.2% to roughly $85,600 after sellers rejected another push above $87,000, the third failed attempt since September 23. Rising bond yields are the headwind: the 10-year Treasury sits near 5.32%, its highest zone since 2002, even as the Nasdaq 100 closed at a record. Today also marks one year since bitcoin's $126,000 all-time high. Read full story 🔓 FinCEN Scraps Self-Custody Wallet and Mixer Reporting Rules The U.S. Treasury's FinCEN withdrew two long-pending proposals: a December 2020 rule that would have forced banks and exchanges to verify and report crypto transfers above $10,000 to or from self-hosted wallets, and a 2023 plan to impose extra reporting on international crypto-mixing transactions. Neither ever took effect. FinCEN said the mixer rule risked chilling legitimate activity, though it will keep monitoring mixers. More details ⚖️ CFTC Proposes Federal Framework for Leveraged Retail Crypto Trading The CFTC opened rulemaking on federal rules for leveraged, margined and financed retail crypto trading. The advance notice introduces Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM plus a new "crypto asset market" registration category, with customer trades routed through registered futures commission merchants. Chair Michael Selig acknowledged the agency cannot force spot trading onto its venues without Congress; public comments run for 60 days. Read more ⚡ Solana Launches Seconds-Fast Institutional Settlement With JPMorgan Input The Solana Foundation released Solana DvP, an open-source, MIT-licensed delivery-versus-payment program that settles the asset and cash legs of a trade in one atomic transaction, with finality in seconds instead of the usual one to two days. JPMorgan advised on institutional settlement requirements. The program has passed external security audits, and privacy features for confidential settlement are planned.
